d: The Purchasing Agent is responsible for planning, sourcing, and procuring materials, equipment, and services required for the successful execution of construction projects. The role ensures that procurement activities are carried out efficiently, cost-effectively, and in accordance with project specifications, company policies, and quality standards. Working closely with project teams, suppliers, and internal stakeholders, the Purchasing Agent manages supplier relationships, obtains competitive quotations, issues purchase orders, monitors deliveries, resolves procurement-related issues, and maintains accurate purchasing records to support project timelines and organizational objectives.
q: Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, Procurement, or a related field.
Minimum 3–5 years of procurement or purchasing experience, preferably within the construction industry.
Strong knowledge of procurement processes, purchasing practices, and supplier management.
Familiarity with construction materials, equipment, and vendor markets.
Proven ability to negotiate contracts, pricing, and commercial terms with suppliers.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to evaluate supplier performance and purchasing requirements.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills for effective coordination with internal stakeholders and external vendors.
Strong organizational and time-management skills with the ability to manage multiple procurement activities simultaneously.
High level of attention to detail and accuracy in purchase orders, contracts, and procurement documentation.
Proficiency in ERP systems and Microsoft Office applications.
Ability to work collaboratively within cross-functional teams and support project delivery objectives.
Sound understanding of company policies, compliance requirements, and procurement best practices.
r: li
Source, evaluate, and select suppliers and vendors for materials, equipment, and services.
li
Obtain quotations and negotiate pricing, payment terms, and delivery schedules with suppliers.
li
Prepare, issue, and follow up on purchase orders in accordance with project requirements and approved budgets.
li
Coordinate with project managers, site engineers, and other stakeholders to ensure procurement needs are met on time.
li
Monitor supplier performance and ensure timely delivery of materials and services.
li
Resolve procurement-related issues, including delivery delays, quality concerns, and invoice discrepancies.
li
Maintain accurate records of purchases, supplier information, quotations, contracts, and procurement activities.
li
Ensure all procurement activities comply with company policies, procedures, and quality standards.
li
Support cost control initiatives by identifying cost-saving opportunities and securing competitive pricing.
li
Track and report procurement progress, expenditures, and supplier performance.
li
Build and maintain effective relationships with suppliers and internal stakeholders.
li
Perform any other procurement-related duties assigned by the Procurement Manager.

d: WOB is evolving toward an Integrated Brand, Creative & Growth agency model, helping clients build stronger brands through strategic marketing, creative campaigns, content, production, and growth-focused services.

We are looking for a Senior Sales Executive – KSA to manage commercial relationships with existing clients, drive contract renewals, follow up on quotations and commercial agreements, support payment collection, and convert qualified inbound leads and referrals into business opportunities.

This is a client-facing role that requires a strong commercial mindset, excellent relationship management skills, and the ability to maintain consistent follow-up while protecting client relationships and company profitability.
q: 2–4 years of relevant experience in B2B sales, agency sales, client commercial management, or a similar client-facing sales role.
Experience in marketing, advertising, creative, digital, media, production, events, or other service-based businesses is highly preferred.
Proven experience in client renewals, quotation preparation, commercial negotiations, contracts, purchase orders, and payment follow-up.
Strong understanding of selling services and customized solutions, rather than only physical products.
Experience managing existing clients and warm leads while maintaining an organized sales pipeline and accurate CRM records.
Saudi market experience and the ability to conduct in-person client meetings are required or strongly preferred.
Excellent Arabic communication skills and professional proficiency in English.
Proficiency in CRM systems, spreadsheets, presentations, quotation templates, email, and professional messaging tools. Familiarity with ClickUp or similar workflow tools is an advantage.
Experience handling agency retainers, renewals, and marketing-services contracts.
Exposure to creative campaigns, digital marketing, social media, influencer marketing, production, events, or integrated marketing services.
Experience dealing with marketing managers, business owners, procurement teams, finance teams, and senior decision-makers.
Familiarity with Saudi commercial documentation, including quotations, purchase orders, VAT-related requirements, and company documents.
Experience working alongside a Business Developer or Commercial Lead while independently managing renewals and day-to-day sales activities.
r: li
Client Renewals & Retention: Manage renewal calendars, follow up on contract expirations, prepare renewal options, and support commercial discussions to maintain long-term client relationships.
li
Quotations & Proposals: Prepare accurate quotations and commercial proposals based on approved pricing, scope, and management guidelines, and follow up until a clear outcome is reached.
li
Commercial Negotiation: Handle commercial discussions within approved authority, protect profitability, and escalate non-standard pricing, discounts, or contractual commitments for approval.
li
Contracts & Documentation: Follow up on contracts, purchase orders, signatures, renewal documents, and other commercial paperwork, ensuring records are properly maintained.
li
Payment Follow-up: Coordinate with Finance and clients regarding payment schedules, overdue invoices, outstanding balances, and collection-related queries.
li
Inbound Leads & Referrals: Qualify warm leads, referrals, and inbound inquiries in Saudi Arabia, arrange meetings, prepare commercial offers, and follow opportunities through to closure.
li
Client Meetings & Market Presence: Represent WOB professionally in client meetings, commercial follow-ups, renewal discussions, and local business interactions.
li
CRM & Sales Reporting: Maintain accurate sales records, update opportunity stages and next actions, and provide regular reports on renewals, quotations, payment risks, and pipeline status.
li
Upselling & Cross-selling: Identify relevant opportunities for additional WOB services in coordination with Account Management and the relevant departments.
li
Internal Coordination & Handover: Ensure closed deals and renewals are handed over to Account Management with clear documentation of scope, pricing, payment terms, timelines, and client commitments.
li

Business Development Support: Support the Business Developer and management team with local introductions, meeting coordination, vendor registration follow-up, and Saudi market insights when required.
